name: mr-brief
description: Merge request descriptions a reviewer actually reads: fifteen lines, three key changes, three verified places to look, one risk, a diagram only when the wiring moved.

interface.longDescription: Turns a branch diff into a fifteen-line brief: what changed, the three decisions worth arguing about, three permalinks verified against the commit, one risk line, and a sequence diagram only when a call path moved. Asks before writing; never attaches without a second yes.
defaultPrompt: Write an mr-brief for this branch.
Use mr-brief to describe this pull request.
Lint this PR description with mr-brief.
